comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
These are great often overlooked fairly cheap player made ships good for 3 purposes: 1) An iron one makes a great low-mid level battle grinder since 8/28/0 is fairly easy to reach, and at 135 crew, 48(3 X 16's) guns and 616 dura is the best low Battle level fighting ship you can get for under 7m that's good for grinding Cannon skills and has a high enough crew to fend off most melee attack attempts by NPC's in galley-type ships. 2) An r20 SB built one makes a decent aide ship with 661 cargo(more if you FS build it and use the right parts), and getting an aide to 8/28/0 is not that terribly hard to do. 3) An r20 SB built one makes a great alt ship for extra trade goods storage, and getting an alt to 8/28/0 is relatively easy to do.
